Music — Ashish & Bittu
----------------------
Put your song here, named exactly:

  our-song.mp3

It will play on loop from the player at the bottom of the page.
If the file is missing, the player falls back to a soft ambient
instrumental built into the app (so the button always works).

Suggested: "Mere Mehboob Qayamat Hogi" (Kishore Kumar) or a soft
flute instrumental. Please use a copy you own — the site does not
bundle any copyrighted audio.
